title: Dr. Mehmet Güllüoğlu
content:
Dr. Güllüoğlu is a senior diplomat and public health professional with two decades of leadership experience in humanitarian assistance, disaster management and international cooperation. He previously worked as Senior Adviser to the President of Türkiye. Before that, he served as Türkiye's Humanitarian Aid Coordinator for the Occupied Palestinian Territory (OPT) to oversee the coordination and monitoring of Türkiye's humanitarian activities in Gaza.

From 2021 to 2024, he served as Ambassador of Türkiye to the United Republic of Tanzania. Between 2017 and 2021, he headed Türkiye's Disaster and Emergency Management Authority, leading a nationwide structure of 81 provincial directorates, 11 response brigades, roughly 6,000 personnel, and 100,000 volunteers. In this role, he helped develop the national volunteer model that proved vital for disaster response and public awareness.
